title: Valid GitHub access reads do not queue behind credential locks
when: Concurrent git fetches, local API access, refresh or binding
need: Reuse valid stored access without locks or health requests. Validate bundled local App identity without network access on every read. Prove service App identity before refresh or binding; refresh under lock after reading again. A wait cue starts after about two seconds; retry after contention and use yoke github status for persistent failures.
surface: Public GitHub guide and credential wait/refusal messages
review: Source and concurrent regression tests; deployed proof remains pending.
